entities.name: 3-(1H-imidazol-1-yl)propan-1-amine
observations: Decoded as NCCCn1ccnc1; terminal primary amine is the likely nucleophile.
Source search found this as the amine component.

entities.name: 2-aminopyrimidine-5-carboxylic acid
observations: Decoded as Nc1nccnc1C(=O)O; carboxylic acid is the acyl component.
Source search found this as the acid component.

entities.name: 1,1'-carbonyldiimidazole
observations: Decoded as O=C(n1ccnc1)n1ccnc1; used as a carboxylic-acid activating/coupling reagent.

entities.name: N-[3-(1H-imidazol-1-yl)propyl]-2-aminopyrimidine-5-carboxamide
observations: Predicted major product from CDI-mediated amidation.
Formula reported by the search finding: C11H14N6O.

entities.name: CDI-mediated amidation
observations: The heteroaryl carboxylic acid is activated by CDI and then attacked by the terminal primary amine to form the carboxamide.
The ether-like and unresolved amide-like components are likely solvent/additive and are not incorporated; exact identity of the truncated component remains uncertain.
